mapping: Rows: house index 0–4. Columns: original ruler, female heir h1, male heir h2. Identity is bound to person ID, never to current succession rank.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: medieval fantasy strategy game character portrait sprite atlas for Auremarch.
Primary request: exactly FIFTEEN distinct painted head-and-shoulders character portraits, arranged in exactly THREE COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS, filling the entire image as a perfectly regular edge-to-edge grid. Every cell is one separate portrait. This is a tall portrait-format atlas, approximately 3:5 aspect ratio, all cells square. No gutters or outside margins.
Subject: Human nobility of a fertile golden kingdom. Gold brocade, blue cloaks, subtle lion jewelry, warm olive and fair skin tones.
In EACH of the five rows, the LEFT column is a male ruler aged 42–46, the MIDDLE column is a female heir aged 21, the RIGHT column is a male heir aged 18. The top row is the royal family, with subtle small gold circlet on the ruler. The four following rows represent four separate noble families. All fifteen faces must be different identities with familial resemblance within each row; varied hair and facial features, matching specified gender and age.
Style/medium: detailed hand-painted oil and gouache medieval fantasy character illustrations, sophisticated restrained palette, realistic anatomy, painterly brushwork. Like portraits from an illuminated fantasy atlas. Crisp expressive faces at thumbnail size, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: identical close head-and-shoulders crop in each square cell, face centered horizontally with eyes near the upper third, full head safely inside each cell, shoulders at bottom. Each character looks toward the viewer. Dark softly textured individual background, gentle warm side lighting. No objects or anatomy crossing cell boundaries.
Constraints: EXACTLY 3 columns × 5 rows = 15 portraits. No text, names, labels, lettering, borders, grid lines, watermark, UI, logos, landscape scene, duplicated faces, modern clothing or weapons.
